name: Alex Morgan
headline: Senior QA Automation Engineer | Playwright, REST API, CI/CD & SQL
summary: Senior QA Automation Engineer with 9 years of experience who builds and maintains automated test frameworks in Playwright, Selenium, Python and TypeScript for web and REST API testing, and embeds them into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins). Validates data with SQL, works in Agile/Scrum teams, and adds k6 performance and axe-core accessibility checks.

experience.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
bullets: Built a Playwright and TypeScript automation framework for web and REST API testing, integrated into GitHub Actions, running 1,200 tests on every pull request.
Reduced flaky tests by 70% by introducing stable locators, test-data factories and automatic retries with failure screenshots and traces.
Added k6 performance tests for the checkout API, catching two latency regressions before release.
Integrated axe-core accessibility checks into the UI suite and worked with designers to fix WCAG 2.1 AA violations.
Defined the team's test strategy and QA KPIs (automation coverage, escaped defects, pass rate) and reported them to engineering leadership.
Set up nightly cross-browser runs on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with parallel workers, keeping the full regression under 20 minutes.
Partnered with developers in code reviews to add unit and integration tests for new payment features before release.
Used GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT to draft test cases from user stories and acceptance criteria, reviewing every generated test before merging.
Mentored three QA engineers through pairing and code reviews of test code.

experience.title: QA Automation Engineer
bullets: Migrated a manual regression suite of 800 cases to Selenium WebDriver and Java with TestNG, cutting regression time by 60%.
Built REST API tests with RestAssured and Postman collections, run in Jenkins pipelines on every build.
Automated Android and iOS smoke tests with Appium on real devices in BrowserStack.
Validated order and inventory data with SQL queries against PostgreSQL during releases.
Worked in Agile/Scrum sprints with developers and product owners to review acceptance criteria and plan regression scope.
Ran exploratory and risk-based testing sessions on new checkout features, logging 150+ defects with clear reproduction steps.

experience.title: QA Analyst
bullets: Wrote and executed functional, regression and UAT test cases for a B2B SaaS platform in an Agile/Scrum team.
Reported and triaged defects in Jira and contributed Python scripts that generated test data.
Built a smoke-test checklist used for every production deployment, reducing post-release hotfixes.

education: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of North Texas, Denton, TX | August 2012 - May 2016
professional_development: AI Testing (Self-Directed, 2025): LLM evaluation basics and prompt testing for AI features.
